Come join our team!

Want to work with a smart team doing excellent work, opening the native ad industry to fair and transparent competition? At WhizzCo, our publisher-clients love us, because we help them raise revenue on average by 37% simply by opening up their traffic to competition. They appreciate us because we present all data regarding performance and vendors in a clear, transparent, and consistent way. Plus, we are nice, fun people.

Want to join the love-fest? In 2020 our sales climbed 6x and we have even higher aspirations for 2021. In Israel, we are looking for a sales development representative (SDR), a sales intern and a sales researcher.

In the US, we are looking for a publisher account manager and a publisher sales manager to join our team. Check out the qualifications we are looking for below and send your CV to [email protected].

Sales Development Representative - Entry Level

WhizzCo is looking for a Sales Development Representative to assist outreach efforts and generate potential opportunities with publishers and media agencies.

The ideal SDR will assist the sales team in every aspect of the sales process and will be a great fit for our energetic and creative team. You’ll gain hands-on experience working on challenging and meaningful projects in the AdTech industry.

What are some of the things you would do on a day-to-day basis?

  • Reach out and develop opportunities with targeted decision-makers in the online publishing industry.
  • Analyze and research online activity and provide meaningful business insights to the sales team.
  • Maintain and manage a high volume of daily activity and be responsible for meeting SDR metrics and assigned goals.
  • Maintain up-to-date records in CRM
  • Learn and apply sales techniques

What are we looking for?

  • Out-of-the-box thinking and creative approach to customer acquisition.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Very strong verbal and writing English skills
  • Great Excel skills and work experience with CRM systems – an advantage
  • WEBINT/OSINT background – a significant advantage

Publisher Account Manager

WhizzCo is looking for a dedicated, data-driven Publisher Account Manager with a passion for digital media to optimize revenue and serve as a valuable resource/point of contact. The Publisher Account Manager will work with top-tier publishers to help implement and launch the WhizzCo content recommendations platform on their online assets, track post-launch performance, and provide strategic direction for new opportunities to grow revenue. The Account Manager will largely focus on optimizing existing relationships by upselling new initiatives to publishers and improving the metrics on their site.

What are some of the things you do on a day-to-day basis?

  • Manage and grow relationships with premium publisher clients and strategic partners
  • Understand the company’s strategic objectives and map WhizzCo platform capabilities to the needs of the organization
  • Develop relationships at all levels across the organization
  • Understand client strategic objectives & KPIs in order to be able to intelligently identify opportunities and effectively upsell and grow the partnership
  • Monitor and analyze metrics and proactively take initiative to improve results
  • Understand WhizzCo’s platform capabilities and the value proposition to the Publisher based on the specific capability and user role.
  • Become a trusted advisor and single point of contact to the client
  • Work closely with internal WhizzCo teams as the liaison for all business and technical issues and opportunities
  • Be a field advocate and communicate / advocate client needs to the Product Management team.
  • Manage the preparation and presentation of performance reports and market insights to partners to further support growth opportunities and recommendations.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction with the WhizzCo platform and services.

What are the skills a good Publisher Account Manager needs to have?

  • A minimum of 3 years of client-facing experience in the digital media/online publisher space
  • A solid understanding of web technologies and the digital media revenue ecosystem, including web advertising measurements and analytics
  • Outstanding relationship management and customer service skills to go above and beyond for your clients.
  • Very strong analytical skills to collect business intelligence by monitoring/identifying trends with data
  • Highly motivated, proactive, dedicated and creative in order to pull all necessary resources for the client
  • High attention to detail, organized with strong communication skills
  • Experience with CRM software and MS Excel (or Google Sheets)

Publisher Sales Manager

WhizzCo is looking for a strategic Publisher Sales/Development Manager to join our US team.

We are looking for a Publisher Development Manager, responsible for driving publishers’ partnerships. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned ad-tech professional to be a driving force behind growing our reach in the US.

As a Publisher Development Manager, you will prospect, acquire and grow relationships with strategic publishers. The ideal candidate is a well-regarded publisher development professional, experienced in deal-making as well as operational aspects of publisher monetization. The candidate should also have a solid working knowledge of the online advertising industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue from publisher partners to meet and exceed sales goals.
  • Contribute to Whizzco’s publisher development strategies.
  • Build relationships across publisher organizations (executives, sales teams, ad ops, research)
  • Track and manage publisher acquisition pipeline and account activities.
  • Work closely with internal teams on sales strategy, techniques and execution.
  • Manage all facets of the sales process from pre-sale to close, including ongoing sales consultation.
  • Contribute to publisher retention and relationship management, in addition to Account Management, with the goal of ensuring high publisher satisfaction.
  • Where required, be able to present Whizzco’s offering in front of senior Publisher representatives.
  • Build and grow a sales pipeline of premium publishers across the US market.
  • Develop a clear understanding of each publisher’s business and its needs.
  • Educate publishers on developments in the ecosystem and how our product offering addresses the challenges they face.
  • Develop complex sales strategies to identify key decision-makers and stakeholders.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and address contractual concerns to close agreements

Requirements

  • 4+years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience working at an ad serving technology company and/or large media company
  • Strong knowledge of Internet advertising models, ad optimization, audience trends and technologies
  • Strong analytical ability and experience with CPM models
  • An understanding of online advertising
  • Strong negotiation skills and strategic mindset
  • Knowledge of the pre and post-sales process
  • Existing relationships with large premium publishers (highly desirable)
  • Previous experience in digital media with an in-depth understanding of the advertising landscape and publisher tech stack;
  • Strong abilities to persuade at a very senior level of an organization
  • Analytical/strategic thinker, creative problem solver, resourceful, able to initiate change and motivate innovation and creativity.
  • You have a basis for execution and a strong drive and sense of urgency to get things done.
  • Process-driven: tracking, publisher onboarding.
  • Customer-focused – with excellent communication, networking and negotiation skills
  • Energetic – with a high level of initiative and motivation

Sales Intern

WhizzCo is looking for a sales intern to assist in various stages of the sales funnel, including creating awareness of new offerings, generating leads, and retaining customers.

The ideal intern will assist the sales team in almost every aspect of the sales process and will be a great fit for our energetic and creative team. You’ll gain hands-on experience working on challenging, meaningful projects with guidance from the members of our team of professionals.

Responsibilities

  • Working closely with our sales team, completing all allocated tasks.
  • Research and generate lists of potential customers
  • Updating documents and maintain sales records.
  • Reviewing sales performance against sales targets.
  • Observing and carrying out sales processes.
  • Learn and apply sales techniques

Requirements

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment
  • Experience with PowerPoint, Word, and Excel preferred
  • Very good English level

Benefits

  • Work on increasingly challenging and engaging real-world projects
  • Gain hands-on experience in each stage of the sales funnel
  • Collaborate with experienced sales professionals

Sales Research

WhizzCo is looking for a Sales Researcher that will collate sales leads into credible and meaningful information that the team will use to touch base and contact prospective clients.

You’ll gain hands-on experience working on challenging, meaningful projects with guidance from the members of our team of professionals.

Responsibilities

  • The work will be varied; however, the primary function will be to provide research support within the sales team.
  • Provide leads generated by daily review of different sources.
  • Research leads and providing full packages of information
  • Record all opportunities accurately
  • Produce management reports on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis.

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical skills
  • Self-motivated attitude
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment
  • Experience with PowerPoint, Word, and Excel preferred
  • Very good English level
  • Previous experience of using a CRM system is advantageous but not essential
